description: Worked on an on-prem Kubernetes platform: reworked how load was distributed across services, set up request-metric autoscaling with Envoy Gateway and KEDA, and shaped the direction of the team's observability stack.
Evaluated a partner AI vendor from the buyer's side and turned their assurances into written governance commitments. Ran internal workshops on putting AI into everyday deployment and marketing work.
Rebuilt a codebase-grounded coding agent with GraphRAG and LangChain, retrieving over a multi-language code graph in Neo4j. Shipped it to the org-wide agent platform.
Ran empirical experiments on a randomized federated hyperparameter-learning algorithm, testing how it behaves on sparse, non-IID data.
Led a student team building a real-time voice news assistant, and built the serverless RAG pipeline behind it on AWS Lambda and Pinecone.
Built an ECG annotation platform end to end on AWS, so physicians could label diagnoses themselves instead of passing files around on-site.
